verdicts.reason: A is a scaled-down copy of the original with no rearrangement: the geometric background does not fill the portrait canvas, which leaves large blank white bands at the top and bottom. The type block itself stays intact and readable. B has the same unfilled background, and its white frame is badly misplaced: the frame's top edge runs out into the blank white band above the pattern and its bottom edge cuts across the middle of the pattern. The text card is pushed up off-centre and the bottom half of the canvas is dead space, so B looks broken.
